name: Houjou Satoru
source:
He is a good advisor to Masamune. He is the mediator between Masamune and Momoko.

He is quite handsome, but due to some circumstances in his past, he is no longer aggressive with women.

He smilingly watches over Masamune, who is adored by two attractive women.
